reviews.text: The number one for my dog, and therefore for me too. Top-quality and completely non-aggressive products, constant cuddles from Mattia, and perfect drying. My German Shepherd has never been so happy to go for a bath! Everything was perfect!
An incredible experience that led to a one-of-a-kind result. Thank you Mattia! We're thrilled, but Terry is even more so!

This is my first time taking my Spitz Thor and Zeus to this shop. The service and quality are impeccable, but above all, they provide so much care and attention to my furry children. Mattia also gave me excellent tips on how to best brush my two pups. Highly recommended.

It's a shame because I've always had a good experience, but the last time the owner was quite rude. He greeted me by exclaiming, "Come on, hurry up! I had to pick up my daughter from dance class half an hour ago," after receiving a text …
We got along very well with my Penny (a little spinon that's always messy) and she comes out beautifully groomed and smelling good. And he's very sweet with her.

The place is run by meticulous, clean, and professional staff, but my dog ​​went in as a Lagotto (with lots of knots) and came out as an agitated Poodle. I'm sorry. I'd definitely recommend it for other breeds, but for Lagottos, it's a big no.
Mattia, professional, kind, great with dogs. Never without him again!
